boundary: Development software/display change only. No production promotion or new native extraction. Existing scientific segmentation and frozen artifacts preserved.

earlier_interrupted_integrity_check.cause: A source edit overlapped the earlier full-suite run. Its frozen-input guard rejected the changed overview.py. The final complete run used stable code and passed.

resolved_issues: Adverse existing review checks and omissions must remain visible.
Non-blocking revise_record is not labeled advisory.
Mixed material/data alternatives share the original exactly-one group.
Applicability notice remains visible when large choices are folded.
Optional review must bind exact workflow and unique complete target accounting.

visual_check.scope: Default ChIPmentation view screenshot inspected; not a usability study.

known_limits: Prompt granularity adherence not yet measured in a fresh native extraction.
Existing Operations are not automatically merged and supporting experiments are not automatically filtered.
Projection preservation is not scientific truth or source entailment.
